title: The Gauss–Bonnet theorem
summary: Gaussian curvature of surfaces revisited; geodesic curvature and the local Gauss–Bonnet formula for a region bounded by a piecewise smooth curve; the global theorem ∫_M K dA = 2πχ(M) for compact oriented surfaces; the theorema egregium and holonomy as the structure-equation route; the sphere of radius R as the check (K = R^{-2}, area 4πR², χ = 2).

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is Wendl §6.3 (the Gauss–Bonnet formula) with §6.2, Sternberg §4.5 (Gauss' theorems: structure equations, theorema egregium, holonomy, §4.5.5 Gauss–Bonnet), and Lee chapter 9 as the commercial reference. The primary Lund notes do not treat Gauss–Bonnet; this unit relies on the open-licensed sources.

preparation.description: Read Wendl §6.3 (the Gauss–Bonnet formula), pp. 138–152, after reviewing §6.2 (hypersurfaces and Gaussian curvature).
Read Sternberg §4.5 (Gauss' theorems), pp. 103–105: structure equations of a surface, theorema egregium, holonomy, §4.5.5 Gauss–Bonnet.
